evidence.ACL: Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Displaced radial tear at the anterior horn and complex tear (main horizontal component) at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Horizontal tear at the anterior horn, body and complex tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Diffuse low grade chondrosis along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the left knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema and osteophytes.
evidence.PF OA: Focal cartilage fissuring at the medial and lateral patellar facets.
evidence.Effusion: Large amount of left knee effusion with synovitis.
evidence.Synovitis: Large amount of left knee effusion with synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: There is focal high grade chondrosis (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) with subchondral edema at posterior weightbaring medial femoral condyle
